posts.cooked:
One thing that has been a bit annoying while playing the app is that it seems like all of the options are on the left side of the screen, but all of the confirmations and on the very right. NOt just confirmation for attacking which can have me move the mouse around the screen several times, but also double clicking a card on the left side of the screen, only brings up a confirmation on the right. I am assuming this was on purpose, maybe to prevent an accidental clicking of confirm, but it is slightly annoying.

On a somewhat related note, is there a reason there is no option to select the character when you double click the pic on the setup screen?
